zga_verify_fixed_scoreboard_slots_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zga_board_rows value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zga_board_valid_rows value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zga_board_375 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zga_board_35 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zga_board_325 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_char }
		change_variable = { name = zga_board_rows add = 1 }
		debug_log = "ZGA: DATA player_scoreboard_row 01"
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_kpi
				has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_rank

			}

		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_sb_m_01_grade = 3.75 }
			change_variable = { name = zga_board_375 add = 1 }

		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_sb_m_01_grade = 3.5 }
